title: Fix the Invalid Overload by Return Type
description: The program should define two versions of a method that computes an area, for integer and decimal dimensions.
expectedBehavior: The program should compile and print the computed area.
actualProblem: Both computeArea methods have the exact same name and parameter list (int, int) and differ only in return type. Java does not allow overloading based on return type alone, so the compiler rejects this as 'method computeArea(int,int) is already defined'.
explanation: Method overloading in Java is distinguished by the parameter list (number, order, or types of parameters), never by return type alone. Giving the double version genuinely different parameter types resolves the conflict.
